fields.label: Webhook Secret
fields.description: Dedicated secret for verifying Paystack webhook signatures. If left empty, the Secret Key is used.

fields.label: Test Mode
fields.description: Required when the keys above are Paystack test keys (sk_test_/pk_test_), and refused when they are live keys. Webhook signatures and transactions are verified either way.

fields.label: Auto Refund on Credit Note
fields.description: Automatically initiate a Paystack refund when a credit note is submitted against a Paystack-paid invoice.

fields.label: Allowed Webhook IPs
fields.description: One IP address or CIDR range per line. Only requests from these are accepted for the webhook; empty allows all. Paystack currently sends from 52.31.139.75, 52.49.173.169 and 52.214.14.220 - confirm against https://paystack.com/docs/payments/webhooks before entering them, because a stale list rejects live payments.
Inline shows the Paystack popup on the app's own checkout page. Hosted redirects the customer to a Paystack-hosted page.
fields.label: Checkout Mode

fields.description: Hours a checkout link stays payable. 0 keeps links valid indefinitely.
fields.label: Payment Link Validity (Hours)

fields.description: The bank account Paystack pays out to. Set this and the fee account to have each Paystack payout post a journal entry clearing the suspense account.
fields.label: Settlement Bank Account

fields.description: Expense account Paystack's fees are booked to when a payout is settled. The fee is recognised at payout, not at capture.
fields.label: Paystack Fee Account

fields.description: Charge a customer's saved card for invoices an ERPNext Subscription raises. ERPNext keeps the billing calendar; Paystack only collects. Leave off to collect subscription invoices by hand.
fields.label: Auto Charge Subscription Invoices
